statement: The explicit Stewart–Gough platform in Table 2 has forty numerically distinct real direct-kinematic postures.

Table 3 lists the forty posture vectors and Figures 3–4 display them. The example deforms a design with six real postures, turning seventeen conjugate pairs into real pairs. This is numerical realization evidence without exact certification in this article.
scope: Six fixed-length SPS legs connecting specified base and moving-platform anchors in three dimensions.
